Cabinet Office spend over GBP 25,000 (core), 12 monthly CSVs, fetched 2026-10-15. OGL v3.0.
Trimmed for privacy. Every row stays at its original line number. Ref and Transaction number
are blanked; every Supplier whose 12-month total (all 12 files) is below 1,000,000 pounds is
replaced by 'WITHHELD (fixture)'. Amount, Date and Expense Type are unchanged, so totals match
the publisher. Original encoding, CRLF line endings and trailing blank rows are kept.
